title: BTC, ETH, and basket transmission
claim: Lagged BTC, ETH, or basket innovations may improve asset return forecasts beyond own-market state at a development-selected frozen horizon.
mechanism: Common-market information can be incorporated at different rates, but leadership and sign are empirical questions.
target: Outright or factor-residual basket-member log return.
horizon: Locked campaign horizon grid; one horizon frozen before confirmation.
informationSet: Causal BTC, ETH, equal-weight basket, and own-asset market state
primaryBaseline: Strongest market-state model without transmission features

evidence.summary: Positive development loss differences appeared in both observed baskets, but the leading model family differed, basket 6 was unfinished, no exact cross-basket specification had complete placebo evidence, and basket 10 was untested.

nextAction: Keep V2 suspended and preserve the model-family instability. Any V3 must preregister one mechanism and exact specification against fresh evidence rather than continue this search.
